Factor's prepared meal delivery makes eating well easy!

Our nutritious meal plans offer 29+ meals and recipes every week from a rotating menu that feature options from Keto, Vegan, Vegetarian, low-carb, and low-calorie diets. You can also add snacks, drinks and other wholesome add-ons to your food delivery order.

So, what sets Factor apart from other meal kit delivery options?

_Pre-Made Meals Are Ready to Eat in Minutes_
Forget about searching for healthy recipes that fit your diet. Our food delivery service sends prepared meals straight to your doorstep so you can spend less time prepping, cooking, and cleaning and more time savoring nutritious meals.

_Dietitan-Approved Recipes That Use Quality Ingredients_
All of our recipes are designed by dietitians who specialize in healthy eating and are crafted by chefs who make sure our meal plans only use the highest quality, freshest ingredients available. You can rest easy knowing that every premade meal you receive from Factor will take you one step closer to a healthier lifestyle.

_Special Diets Made Simple_
Whether you're an omnivore or follow a plant-based diet, the Factor app offers ready to eat meals for the most popular diet plans, including:

+ Keto Diet
+ Vegan Diet
+ Vegetarian Diet
+ Low Calorie Diet
+ Low Carb Diet

_Flexibility in Every Meal Plan_
Choose from a variety of dietitian-approved meal plans with 4 to 18 rotating options every week. Need to skip a week? No problem! Our meal plans can be paused in case you're heading out of town for a couple of days, or expanded on for weeks when you expect to need some extra meals for the weeks where cooking just isn't an option.

_A Meal Plan Personalized For You_
The Factor food delivery app provides meals that fit all tastes and preferences. When you make choices to your meal plans, our app will personalize future weekly meal selections to keep you diet fun and exciting.

_Our Customer Service Team is Here to Support Your Goals for Healthier Eating_
Our customer experience team is always available to help answer questions and ensure you're fully enjoying your meal plan! Contact us directly through your Factor app, call us at (888) 573-5727, or email us at help@factor75.com for assistance.
